verdict.rationale: Clerk's own docs describe Organizations for building multi-tenant B2B apps (Slack/Linear/Vercel-style), with users belonging to multiple orgs. Each session carries org context (memberships, roles, active org), and default admin/member roles can be extended with custom roles and permissions. Prebuilt drop-in components let users create and switch orgs and view memberships and invitations. A community complaint that roles are org-scoped rather than global is about cross-tenant admin, not org modeling, so it does not contradict the story. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the invitation flow (sending, accepting and revoking invites), and independent hands-on corroboration of the org and invitation features.
